Name: Movie Theater Concessions Recipes
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]Compatible with 1.6 Update[/size]

[line]
[size=5]Features[/size]

This mod adds the movie theater concessions as food and recipes. There are now several version of this mod:

1. Original features: All recipes can be purchased from Gus in the saloon at any time. I preserved the Likes/Dislikes of all villagers so they match the concessions you buy
from the movie theater.

2. Movie Theater Required: The movie theater must be built and entered at least once (you must buy a ticket to enter) in order for the recipes to be available at the saloon.

3. New Crops: 4 new crops are added to the game to make 4 of the recipes. They can be purchased from Pierre's general store in their corresponding season.
[spoiler]
Anise flower- Grows in the fall, required to make Black Licorice
Jasmine flower- Grows in the spring, required to make Jasmine Tea
Peanut- Grows in the summer, required to make Salted Peanuts
Chickpea- Grows in the summer, required to make Hummus Snack Pack
[/spoiler][s]
[/s]4. New Crops and Movie Theater Required: Includes both of the new features.

[size=5]Update Log[/size]

Version 1.1- Updated compatibility with 1.6. No longer requires Json Assets.  Added 1 new version that requires the movie theater to be built to purchase recipes. Added 1 new version that adds 4 new crops and uses their ingredients in their corresponding recipes. Added 1 new version with both new features.
